Title: Analyst, Analytics, Data Science
Description: Rise is an award-winning , full-service Media Agency of Record that is backed by data and powered by people. We create omnichannel experiences using our proprietary tech stack and advanced analytics capabilities to help solve the unique struggles brands face today. This approach, with transparency at its core , specializes in omnichannel media, commerce and retail media, advanced in-home media, as well as content and creator marketing. We offer "Risers" the opportunity to work in an ever-evolving industry that will foster learning and development, provide an innovative work environment with diverse projects and clients, career advancement paths a collaborative team environment, corporate social responsibility initiatives, an inclusive and diverse culture, plus association with a reputable media agency. We're looking for talent like you who can continue to elevate our work and culture. GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB As a Data Scientist on Quad's Insights and Analytics team, you will play an important role in driving the effectiveness of media campaigns through advanced data analysis. You will be responsible for executing modeling projects using a variety of home-grown and 3rd-party tools. This includes data cleansing, formatting, loading, execution, model evaluation, and result reviews. In collaboration with the broader team, you will help craft the insights from these models and turn those insights into recommendations for our clients. Throughout the process, we expect you to seek ways to improve the processes. Location: Mexico City, 3 days in office; Applicants must hold Mexican citizenship Key Responsibilities Model Execution: Load, execute, and refine statistical and machine learning models to assess and improve media effectiveness. Develop processes and data pipelines to support media planning and optimization. Data Analysis: Conduct thorough analyses of media performance data, including engagement metrics, conversion rates, and ROI. Identify trends, patterns, and insights to inform media strategy. Insights Generation: Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable insights. Prepare detailed reports and visualizations that communicate the impact and effectiveness of media strategies. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including media planners, marketing strategists, and data engineers, to ensure alignment of data insights with overall media strategy. Continuous Improvement: Stay curious about the latest industry trends and advancements in data science and media analytics. Propose and implement improvements to existing models and methodologies. Job Requirements Proven experience in data science, particularly in building and deploying predictive, explanatory, or decomposition models. Strong proficiency in statistical analysis and machine learning techniques. Experience with data visualization tools and techniques for effective communication of insights. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex data clearly and understandably. Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. Good English proficiency, recognizing that your manager is bilingual and will aid where necessary. Education Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. A Master's degree or higher is preferred. Experience Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in data science or analytics, with a focus on media effectiveness, marketing analytics, or related areas. Experience working in an agency or client-facing role is a plus. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R. Experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) and machine learning frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow), mathematical and statistical modeling, Bayesian methods, optimization techniques, and simulation. Data Tools: Expertise in SQL for querying databases, and familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar. Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to interpret data and develop actionable insights. Communication: Ability to convey complex data insights and technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Time Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. Collaboration: Strong team player with experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Marketing Interest and Initiative: Strong interest in marketing and a proactive attitude toward learning new concepts, tools, and strategies, with the initiative to apply knowledge and contribute to business objectives.

Title: Senior Water Data Scientist
Description: This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You can be based in our office in our office in Washington, DC or Mexico City, Mexico .  Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position. To be eligible for this position in US, you must be a resident of DC, Maryland or Virginia at the start of employment. The Senior Water Data Scientist will serve as the technical and scientific lead for a flagship initiative focused on advancing how the impacts of nature-based solutions (NBS) and green-gray infrastructure (GGI) on water security outcomes are measured and monitored across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) and beyond. This role will help shape a next-generation approach to understanding causal inference and attribution for how NBS influence water availability, water quality, hydrologic regulation, drought resilience, flood risk, and watershed resilience, by convening partners to build the scientific methodologies and digital architecture that will make monitoring and measuring the water outcomes of NBS credible and accessible at scale. The Senior Water Data Scientist will work with an interdisciplinary team across WRI’s Cities4Forests, Water Program, Global Nature Watch, Data Lab, and regional offices to identify, evaluate, and apply the best available science, data, models, artificial intelligence (AI) tools, and other emerging technologies for impact measurement and monitoring (IMM). The role will help bridge cutting-edge scientific research with practical implementation needs for utilities, investors, governments, and practitioners. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: planetary causal inference -> integrating planetary-scale data and localized information to derive insights about causality AI, machine learning and data-driven environmental modeling -> Orchestrating research and scientific development with AI, such as expertise with geospatial foundation models (GFMs), experience with AI-assisted coding, and firm foundation in statistical and machine learning methods remote sensing and Earth observation geospatial analytics and environmental monitoring environmental data systems and impact measurement frameworks hydrology and watershed science forest-water dynamics and ecosystem processes integrated water resources management The role requires a strong ability to synthesize emerging science and technology into actionable methodologies, frameworks, and recommendations that support investment-ready, scientifically credible approaches to monitoring water outcomes from NBS and GGI. Scientific Leadership (50%) Lead the technical development of research and analytical approaches related to measuring and monitoring the impacts of NBS and GGI on water security outcomes in LAC. Lead and contribute to landscape syntheses, technical assessments, and methodological reviews related to hydrology, watershed monitoring, Earth observation, remote sensing, AI-enabled analytics, and environmental data systems. Identify scientific, methodological, and data gaps that constrain credible measurement of water outcomes from NBS and GGI and help define pathways for future innovation and system-scale monitoring breakthroughs. Evaluate the strengths, limitations, feasibility, and investment relevance of existing and emerging monitoring approaches, indicators, and data products. Develop scientifically rigorous and policy-relevant recommendations for impact measurement and monitoring frameworks, indicators, methodologies, and monitoring strategies. Possibility to manage other technical experts to deliver the project. AI-Enabled Methods & Monitoring (20%) Manage, analyze, and synthesize large and complex environmental datasets, including hydrologic, geospatial, remote sensing, climate, and ecological datasets. Contribute technical expertise to the development of pilot monitoring approaches and applied field implementations with regional partners. Support development and evaluation of advanced analytical approaches, including geospatial modeling, machine learning, AI-enabled workflows, and satellite-based monitoring systems where relevant. Author and co-author high-quality knowledge products including reports, technical papers, synthesis documents, presentations, blogs, and peer-reviewed publications. Help shape a long-term “technical vision” related to scalable water monitoring systems, foundational environmental datasets, and future “water cycle intelligence” approaches. Project Development and Project Management (15%) Co-lead the development and implementation of a multi-year initiative advancing water security impact measurement and monitoring for nature-based solutions and green-gray infrastructure. Coordinate interdisciplinary collaboration across WRI teams and external partners, including research institutions, utilities, NGOs, technical advisors, and implementation partners. Manage technical workstreams, project deliverables, timelines, peer review processes, and partner relationships to ensure high-quality project execution. Co-lead the design and implementation of pilot projects and demonstration activities to test, validate, and refine monitoring approaches under real-world conditions. Contribute to fundraising, proposal development, strategic partnerships, and donor engagement to expand WRI's water security and environmental data portfolio. Stakeholder Engagement (15%) Engage with technical experts, research institutions, NGOs, governments, utilities, companies, and other stakeholders (including those in Latin America and the Caribbean) to support knowledge exchange, collaboration, and applied learning. Coordinate and contribute technical expertise to technical advisory group, including leading discussions, workshops, webinars, and external convenings. Prepare presentations, briefings, and technical materials for internal and external audiences, including funders and senior decision-makers. Help communicate complex scientific and technical concepts to non-technical audiences in clear, actionable, and decision-relevant ways. Support coordination of project reporting, partner communications, and funder deliverables. What Will You Need Education: A BA or BS degree (Graduate Degree preferred) in a relevant field: environmental science (such as hydrology, ecology, or water resource management), geographic science (such as remote sensing and satellite technology), or data science and programming (such as computer science, machine learning or artificial intelligence), or a related field required. Master’s Degree or PhD strongly preferred. Experience: A minimum of 10 years of full-time work experience in environmental or climate science or a related field with rigorous quantitative and/or scientific components and a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of interdisciplinary and multicultural teams. Experience working with Artificial Intelligence and data science is important. You have a proven ability to synthesize data analysis and research into policy-relevant written products. Languages: Written and verbal proficiency in English, additional proficiency in Spanish is strongly preferred. Requirements: Existing work authorization is required where this position is based. WRI is unable to authorize visa work authorization. Potential Salary If based in the US: $139-175K If located in another country office, salary will be determined by local market conditions. How To Apply Salary is commensurate with experience and other compensable factors. Please submit a resume with a cover letter by September 24 , 2026 . Internal applicants should submit their application through the Jobs Hub portal in Workday. External applicants must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates. What We Offer Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields across Asia, Africa, Europe, Latin America and the US The chance to have an impact and to develop your career within a mission driven organization with access to varied learning and training opportunities A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours Generous leave days that increase with tenure. If based in the US: Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, retirement plan access and employer contribution. About Us World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyse change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations. Our Mission And Values WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations. Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership and Care. Our Culture WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status. Our People team carefully reviews all applications.

Title: Marketing Data Scientist
Description: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! You will sit at the intersection of marketing strategy and commercial outcomes, building the predictive models and analytical frameworks that tell us where growth is coming from before it arrives. Your work will directly shape how we reach the right audiences, invest in the right channels, and accelerate pipeline - turning marketing activity into a measurable, forward-looking revenue engine. from awareness and demand generation through pipeline to closed revenue - and how data flows across it Strong business acumen with the ability to connect predictive model outputs to strategic marketing and revenue decisions The ability to influence RevOps, Sales, and Marketing stakeholders through data-led storytelling A rigorous yet pragmatic approach to forecasting - Snowflake, AWS, GCP, or Azure for data extraction and model deployment Version Control - Git/GitHub or GitLab Spreadsheet & Presentation Tools - Excel, Google Sheets for stakeholder-facing outputs What we consider a plus: Experience with customer lifetime value (LTV) modeling and churn prediction Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and how they feed into Salesforce (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot) Experience with lead-to-revenue funnel analytics in a B2B SaaS environment Working knowledge of digital marketing platforms and their underlying data structures Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science Disclaimer: The posted range represents the good faith salary for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined by factors including (but not limited to) geographic location, relevant experience, specific skill sets, and internal equity. There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

Title: Manager, Commercial Performance Analytics.
Description: Work Location Assignment: Mexico City, must be able to work from assigned Pfizer office 2-3 days per week , or as needed by the business. Role Summary Commercial Analytics harnesses the power of data to drive robust analytical insights that inform some of Pfizer’s most critical business questions. With colleagues across the globe, the Commercial Analytics team’s rigorous analytical expertise is depended on as the compass for decision support across the enterprise. Our dynamic, exciting team of subject-matter experts comes from diverse backgrounds and experiences, including data science, commercial analytics, finance, market research, and consulting. As a team, we collaborate to turn data into meaningful insights that will have a direct impact on patients’ lives and the future of Pfizer as a data-driven organization. We are seeking a Manager, Commercial Performance Analytics to serve as a hands-on individual contributor within our Mexico City analytics capability center, building the datasets, pipelines, and analytical assets that power performance tracking and insight generation for the commercial organization. This role designs and automates scalable analytics solutions in SQL, Python, and R, while partnering closely with US-based Performance Analytics and Insights (PAI) colleagues as its primary point of collaboration. Working from PAI-defined priorities, the successful candidate will help standardize and centralize the commercial analytics and reporting ecosystems and implement industry best practices in performance analytics and insight-generation processes. This role is dynamic, fast-paced, highly collaborative, and covers a broad range of strategic topics that are critical to our business. The successful candidate will join Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) colleagues worldwide who are dedicated to driving business through proactive thought leadership, innovative technical capabilities, and the ability to communicate complex and dynamic information in new and creative ways. Role Responsibilities Technical Development & Analytics Solutions Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytics solutions using SQL, Python, R, and related technologies. Build, optimize, and automate datasets, data pipelines, and reporting frameworks to support commercial performance measurement. Engineer and integrate data from multiple internal and external sources to create robust analytical datasets. Develop and maintain high-quality analytical assets, including dashboards, reporting tools, and reusable code libraries. Improve performance, reliability, and scalability of existing analytics workflows through automation and process optimization. Leverage AI, scripting, and emerging analytical technologies to increase efficiency and analytical capabilities. Analysis & Insight Generation Perform advanced analyses on patient, HCP, payer, and commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks. Apply statistical, quantitative, and machine learning techniques to solve business problems and generate actionable insights. Conduct data quality assessments, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy and consistency of analytical outputs. Translate complex analytical findings into clear insights supported by quantitative evidence. Collaboration & Partnership Partner closely with US-based PAI colleagues as the primary point of collaboration, supporting shared analytics priorities and delivering against team-defined requirements. Translate information needs surfaced by PAI leads into robust analytical solutions, connecting datasets to tell a clear, compelling story backed by quantitative evidence. Work with PAI and broader analytic functions to advance the use of novel data sources and improve reporting processes, tools, and standards. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, engineering, economics, statistics or related field. 5+ years of experience in Biopharma, analytics, strategic healthcare consulting, or related fields. Extensive expertise in SQL, Python, R, or similar; other object-oriented programming languages. Advanced knowledge of scripting tool and creation of AI agents for automation. Understanding of data visualization tools and experience designing and building complex dashboards, including but not limited to Tableau, PowerBI, Qlik and similar. Analytics, statistics and/or database knowledge and experience (using tools, applications, platforms, etc.). Hands on experience in data types/formats, data architecture, pipeline/ETL optimization Knowledge of data cloud platforms like Snowflake preferred. Strong Project Management Skills: Overseeing complex, cross-functional projects, ensuring delivery on time and within budget. Collaboration: Ability to prioritize, and developing action plans. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Recent Healthcare Life Sciences (pharma preferred) and ecosystem professional industry experience is preferred; commercial analytics experience is a plus. Estamos creciendo rápidamente en todo el país, con un propósito claro: transformar la experiencia de salud para las Grandes Personas, haciéndola más humana, accesible y digna. Sobre el puesto Buscamos un(a) Sr. Analytics Engineer con inclinación a plataforma de datos: la persona que se hace dueña del *cómo*. Vas a diseñar los contratos de datos y el modelado analítico que hacen que un número signifique lo mismo en cualquier canal, y a sostener la plataforma que lo hace posible - ingesta, orquestación, calidad y documentación. Es un rol senior, hands-on y de alta influencia: pones la vara técnica, mentoreas al equipo y te sientas en la mesa donde producto, negocio e ingeniería toman decisiones. Nuestra ambición es clara: pasar de responder bien lo que ya se pregunta, a anticipar la pregunta, y de ahí a modelos predictivos corriendo en producto. Este rol es la pieza que hace ese salto sostenible. Responsabilidades: Diseñar y operar contratos de datos. Una tabla por número crítico, acordada con el equipo dueño del dominio, versionada en dbt con commits, tests y catálogo. Ser dueño(a) del modelado analítico. Capas, convenciones y modelo dimensional en dbt, con documentación y CI que eviten que la deuda entre por la puerta. Fortalecer la plataforma de datos. Ingesta (Airbyte), orquestación (Dagster), calidad y observabilidad: que las anomalías nos avisen antes de que alguien las reporte. Habilitar self-service real. Capa semántica y modelos en Omni y Hex para que quien pregunta pueda responderse solo, con Data como guía y revisor. Construir los entregables de alta confianza. Dashboards y reportes para board, aliados externos y reporteo regulatorio, donde el margen de error es cero. Trabajar cerca del dominio. Embedded con un equipo de producto/negocio, aportando además al trabajo transversal de contratos, calidad y estándares. Subir la vara del equipo. Code review, pairing y mentoría técnica; estándares que se sostienen sin ti en la sala. Habilitar Data Science y ML. Datasets, features y pipelines confiables para que los modelos lleguen a producción y sus resultados regresen al producto. Valores: Medimos el trabajo por impacto , no por horas. Proactividad y productividad son igual de importantes.⁠ Rapidez ≠ velocidad (buscan “velocidad” con dirección intencionada).⁠⁠ Constancia y congruencia (alinear lo que hacemos con lo que Koltin y las GPs necesitan).⁠⁠ Honrar el proceso (el proceso importa tanto como el resultado).⁠ Lo que buscamos: 4+ años en datos (analytics engineering, data engineering o BI con modelado fuerte), con al menos 2 operando como senior o referente técnico. SQL avanzado y criterio real de modelado analítico: dimensional, cargas incrementales, idempotencia, manejo de historia. Transformaciones de datos en producción. Experiencia llevando pipelines y transformaciones de datos a producción con herramientas como dbt o equivalentes , definiendo buenas prácticas de estructura, calidad y testing, componentes reutilizables, documentación, CI/CD y orquestación de jobs/workflows. Desarrollo de pipelines y automatización. Experiencia construyendo pipelines, automatizaciones y procesos de datos con Python o tecnologías equivalentes , aplicando buenas prácticas de ingeniería como Git, PRs/code review, testing y CI/CD. Experiencia con un orquestador (Dagster, Airflow) y con ingesta administrada (Airbyte, Fivetran o equivalente). PostgreSQL y/o un warehouse analítico (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery), con desempeño y costo en la cabeza. Haber construido capa semántica o modelos de BI para que otros consulten por su cuenta (Omni, Looker, Hex, Metabase, Power BI, Otras herramientas de BI). Comunicación con negocio. Convertir una pregunta ambigua en una definición de métrica que aguante discusión, y defenderla con datos. Haber mentoreado a otros ingenieros y dejado estándares que sobrevivieron. Español nativo e inglés profesional (documentación y herramientas en inglés). Suma puntos: GCP o AWS e infraestructura como código (Terraform, Pulumi o CDK). Arquitecturas Rest API, GraphQL y Microservicios Experiencia con datos clínicos o de salud y con requerimientos de privacidad y cumplimiento. Conocimientos de arquitecturas OLAP (MOLAP, ROLAP) Haber habilitado trabajo de Data Science / ML : datasets de entrenamiento, features reutilizables, predicciones servidas al producto. Contexto de startup en crecimiento: ambigüedad alta, poca burocracia, prioridades que se mueven. Cómo trabajamos: Dos formas de operar. Self-service (Hex, Omni en Slack, Claude, Ia generativa) para hipótesis y exploración rápida; y entregables construidos por Data cuando la confianza tiene que ser total. Todo request deja capacidad detrás. Cada entrega viene acompañada del modelo y el contrato que evitan volver a resolverlo desde cero. Los datos viven en el dominio que le importan. Data se acerca al equipo, no al revés. Ownership real. Poca jerarquía, criterio propio y espacio para decidir cómo se construyen las cosas. Qué NO es este rol No es un rol de BI o dashboards únicamente: el corazón del trabajo es modelado y plataforma. No es una mesa de ayuda de queries ni un equipo central de reporteo. To help make sense of it all, the DISCO (Data, Insights, Science & Optimization) team: (i) enables the Consumer Product Tech org make data driven decisions that improve the customer retention, engagement and experience on Amazon Music. We build and maintain automated self-service data solutions, data science models and deep dive difficult questions that provide actionable insights. We also enable measurement, personalization and experimentation by operating key data programs ranging from attribution pipelines, northstar weblabs metrics to causal frameworks. (ii) delivering exceptional Analytics & Science infrastructure for DISCO teams, fostering a data-driven approach to insights and decision making. As platform builders, we are committed to constructing flexible, reliable, and scalable solutions to empower our customers. (iii) accelerates and facilitates content analytics and provides independence to generate valuable insights in a fast, agile, and accurate way. This domain provides analytical support for the Consumer Product Tech org to make data driven decisions while launching new features and evaluating existing features with the end goal of improving the customer experience. DISCO team enables repeatable, easy, in depth analysis of music customer behaviors. We reduce the cost in time and effort of analysis, data set building, model building, and user segmentation. Our goal is to empower all teams at Amazon Music to make data driven decisions and effectively measure their results by providing high quality, high availability data, and democratized data access through self-service tools. If you love the challenges that come with big data then this role is for you. We collect billions of events a day, manage petabyte scale data on Redshift and S3, and develop data pipelines using Spark/Scala EMR, SQL based ETL, Airflow services. We are looking for talented, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Data Engineer, who knows how to take on big data challenges in an agile way. Duties include big data design and analysis, data modeling, and development, deployment, and operations of big data pipelines. You'll help build Amazon Music's most important data pipelines and data sets, and expand self-service data knowledge and capabilities through an Amazon Music data university. DISCO team develops data specifically for a set of key business domains like personalization and marketing and provides and protects a robust self-service core data experience for all internal customers. We deal in AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EMR, EC2, DynamoDB, Kinesis Firehose, and Lambda. Your team will manage the data exchange store (Data Lake) and EMR/Spark processing layer using Airflow as orchestrator. You'll build our data university and partner with Product, Marketing, BI, and ML teams to build new behavioural events, pipelines, datasets, models, and reporting to support their initiatives. You'll also continue to develop big data pipelines. Key job responsibilities You will work with Product Managers, Data scientists and other Data Engineers to help design, develop and deliver scalable data analytics platform and data pipeline solutions to support various Science, ML initiatives and at the scale and speed of Amazon Music. In addition, you will help design, develop, and deliver components for the analytics platform at the broader org level and streamline/automate workflows for the broader DISCO organization. A day in the life Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data scientists, business intelligence engineers, to design and architect a modern data analytics platform on AWS, utilizing the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK). Develop robust and scalable data pipelines using SQL/PySpark/Airflow to efficiently ingest, process, and transform large volumes of data from various sources into a structured format, ensuring data quality and integrity. Design and implement an efficient and scalable data warehousing solution on AWS, using appropriate NoSQL/SQL storage and database technologies for structured and unstructured data. Automate ETL/ELT processes to streamline data integration from diverse data sources and ensure the platform's reliability and efficiency. Create data models to support business intelligence, providing actionable insights and interactive reports to end-users. Enable advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities within the platform to derive predictive and prescriptive insights from the data through tools like EMR/SageMaker Notebooks Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, databases, and applications, ensuring low-latency data access for analytics and machine learning tasks. Implement robust security measures and ensure data compliance with internal requirements, industry standards, and regulations to safeguard sensitive information. Work closely with data scientists and business intelligence engineers to understand their requirements and collaborate on data-related projects. Create comprehensive technical documentation for the platform's architecture, data models, and APIs to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintainability. About The Team Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of data engineering experience Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases) Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Sr. Customer Experience Business Architect
Description: About Klar We're turning one of the world's largest underbanked markets into something fairer, simpler, and more transparent. 7 million users served since 2019. Uber's first global credit card, built right here in Mexico. Klar Empresarial, a brand-new B2B solution — Klar Empresarial — bringing agile credit and smart accounts to SMEs who've been ignored by traditional banks for too long. And a full banking license on the horizon, because our customers asked for it and we listened. We move fast, we think big, and we go all in, because as our CEO puts it: "Growing doesn't always mean going further. Sometimes it means going deeper." Behind all of it is a team of 30+ nationalities, working across Mexico City, Berlin, and Argentina, obsessed with building financial products that are simpler, faster, and fairer than anything that came before. This is Klar, and we're seeking the people who'll write the next chapter. Our people If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team that is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here! and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here! Inclusion - We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture. Customer Obsession - We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers & it’s always at the forefront of our decisions. Klarity - We communicate clearly & with authenticity. It’s in our name & it’s what we do. The position and your daily adventures As a Senior CX Specialist, you will play a key role in evolving and scaling our Customer Experience operation. You will own initiatives end-to-end, using data, automation, and AI to identify opportunities, design solutions, and improve both the customer experience and operational efficiency. This is a full-time position based in our Mexico City office with a hybrid model, therefore we are looking forward to seeing you in our office 2-3 times per week. What you can expect: As a Senior CX Specialist, you will play a key role in evolving and scaling our Customer Experience operation. You will own initiatives end-to-end, using data, automation, and AI to identify opportunities, design solutions, and improve both the customer experience and operational efficiency. Your main responsibilities will include: End-to-End Project Ownership: Lead complex CX projects from problem identification and analysis through solution design, implementation, measurement, and iteration. Projects may include automation pilots, new support flows, escalation frameworks, QA improvements, and other initiatives aimed at improving and scaling the operation. AI & Automation: Design, test, and implement automated workflows and AI-powered solutions that improve customer journeys, increase self-service, and reduce operational effort and resolution times. Monitor AI performance and partner with Data & AI teams to continuously improve existing solutions and launch new capabilities. Data-Driven CX Optimization: Analyze operational KPIs, contact drivers, customer behavior, and trends to identify opportunities and root causes. Translate insights into prioritized initiatives and measure their impact on customer experience and operational performance. Scalable Process Design: Map and optimize CX processes end-to-end, identifying opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and self-service. Design solutions that enable the operation to scale without proportionally increasing complexity or manual effort. Knowledge Management: Own and continuously improve the knowledge used by both AI and support agents, ensuring content is accurate, clear, structured, and aligned with current products and processes. Complex Case & Root-Cause Analysis: Support the resolution of cases that require deeper expertise, analysis, or cross-functional coordination. Use complex and recurring cases as a source of insights to identify systemic issues and drive structural improvements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Operations, Data & AI, and other stakeholders to solve customer pain points at the root cause and successfully implement high-impact improvements. What we are looking for: Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline or analytical field. Analytical & Data Skills: Experience with Excel and intermediate knowledge of SQL and Python. Using data to investigate problems, identify patterns, generate actionable insights, and support decision-making. AI & Automation Mindset: Genuine curiosity and interest in AI, automation, and emerging tools, with a desire to apply them to real operational and customer problems. Process & Scalability Mindset: Strong ability to understand complex processes, identify inefficiencies, and design simpler, more scalable solutions. Project Management: Ability to structure and drive initiatives end-to-end, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and follow through from problem identification to measurable results. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex problems and findings into clear, simple, and actionable recommendations. Collaboration: Comfortable working across teams and disciplines, proactively seeking input, challenging ideas constructively, and bringing the right people together to solve problems. English Proficiency: Advanced English level, as most internal communication at Klar takes place in English. Our offer to you: Competitive salary based on performance and experience Chance of earning Klar stock options 15 days of paid vacation per year; plus extended maternity and paternity leaves Vacation premium 30 days of Christmas bonus Food vouchers Medical Insurance Computer device Wellhub subscription to offer mental and physical health Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions via a Mental Health Platform A modern centrally located office in Mexico City with free drinks, snacks, and regular social events International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people A world class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in Klar is a safe place for everyone! We trust our highly skilled and diverse team and we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for new talents to flourish. We value diversity and welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation and identity. Should you require any accommodations through the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know how we can help!

Title: Customer Master Data Analyst
Description: Overview At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What We're Looking For As a Master Data Coordinator II, you will be the guardian of our customer data accuracy, directly impacting our enterprise operations, compliance, and customer experience. You will govern customer master data across our core systems, solve complex data issues, and ensure our order-to-cash processes run smoothly. This role is for you if you treat clean data as a critical deliverable and thrive on ensuring operational excellence in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Key Responsibilities Create, update, validate, block/unblock, and deactivate customer master data records in source and MDM systems (e.g., Oracle EBS, Salesforce, SAP, or equivalent ERP/CRM/MDM platforms) in line with defined data standards and SLAs. Process master data service requests and tickets accurately and within agreed turnaround times; triage, prioritize, and escalate complex or non-standard cases as needed. Perform routine and ad-hoc data quality checks, identify anomalies, and execute remediation (deduplication, standardization, enrichment, and hierarchy maintenance). Investigate and resolve duplicate records; apply merge and survivorship decisions according to governance rules. Validate customer data against external reference sources (tax/VAT IDs, DUNS, sanctions/denied-party screening, address validation) and internal policies. Support compliance and control activities, including SOX-relevant controls, audit evidence requests, and segregation-of-duties requirements. Maintain and update master data documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Collaborate cross-functionally to resolve data issues, support customer onboarding, and unblock downstream order-to-cash processes. Contribute to data governance initiatives, system enhancements, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for MDM/ERP/CRM changes. Generate and review data quality reports and dashboards; track and report on KPIs and SLA performance. Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to Coordinator I / junior team members, including peer review of their work where required. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field — or equivalent work experience. 3+ years of experience in master data management, data administration, data governance, or a related data operations role. Hands-on experience with at least one ERP, CRM, or MDM platform (e.g., Oracle EBS, SAP, Salesforce, Informatica/Reltio MDM). Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (lookups, pivot tables, basic data manipulation). Strong written and verbal communication in English. Ability to independently manage a queue of requests and prioritize against SLAs. Preferred Qualifications Experience specifically with customer master data, including hierarchies, deduplication, and merge/survivorship processes. Familiarity with data quality and reporting tools (Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, or similar). Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOX) and audit support. Exposure to M&A data integration, system migrations, or large-scale data remediation projects. Additional language skills relevant to the region(s) supported. Core Competencies Data quality & accuracy mindset — treats clean data as the deliverable, not an afterthought. Analytical problem-solving — investigates root causes rather than just clearing tickets. Process & control orientation — follows governance rules and respects segregation of duties. Stakeholder collaboration — communicates clearly across business and technical teams. Ownership & time management — manages a workload independently and meets commitments. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Benefits We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary. Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better. Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance. Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community. Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family. About the project: This is enterprise RTCDP delivery with real technical ownership. You'd own the solution end to end: how data is modeled, how identities resolve, how audiences reach their destinations. Not maintenance, not configuration against a design someone handed you. It's also client-facing. You'd be in the room with customer technical teams, leading design conversations and defending recommendations — so the role rewards people who can explain a trade-off as well as implement one. If you like variety over one long-running internal platform, this fits. What you’ll do: Designing XDM schemas, field groups, identity namespaces, and datasets in Adobe Experience Platform. Building ingestion across batch, streaming, and SDK paths — source connectors, HTTP API, Web/Mobile SDK, Data Prep mapping. Configuring identity graphs and merge policies to produce clean, unified Real-Time Customer Profiles. Building audiences (batch, streaming, edge) and activating them to streaming, cloud storage, and custom API destinations. Writing Query Service SQL for profile QA, audience validation, and derived datasets. Integrating RTCDP with the wider Experience Cloud stack (AJO, CJA, Analytics, Target). Implementing governance: DULE labels, consent policies, Privacy Service, sandbox promotion. Troubleshooting ingestion, identity stitching, and activation failures in production. Advising customer stakeholders on design and best practice, and handing over knowledge so what you build survives you. What makes you a great fit: 3+ years hands-on AEP / Real-Time CDP — schemas, profile, identity resolution, segmentation, destinations. Implementation experience, not configuration-only. You should be able to walk through at least two RTCDP builds you personally delivered. Strong SQL. This is the one the hiring manager cares most about — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning, and real Query Service work. 3+ years API integration — REST, auth patterns, Adobe Developer Console / Adobe I/O, OAuth server-to-server. Client-facing consulting experience — leading technical workshops, presenting design decisions, handling scope conversations. Working knowledge of Python. Scripting and automation level is fine — you don't need to be an engineer. JavaScript enough to implement and debug Web SDK / tag-based collection Professional English for daily work with distributed teams and enterprise customers. Title: Solutions Engineer
Description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Role will be based in Mexico City, Mexico We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately help customers grow in their use of Snowflake. As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the AI Data platform space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO: Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at Snowflake customers and prospects Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology; identify use cases, and guide the customer to successfully take them from demo to implementation, and a successful go-live. Present Customers with the innovations in Snowflake and the value these innovations add to their business. Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them. Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing. ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE: Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos. Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics Ability to understand a customer’s specific business problems and translate these to Snowflake use cases University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred Travel Required ABOUT OUR TEAM: Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact?
